stableEvidence: All entries other than assessment-model must equal deterministic baseline evidence in original order
requiredModelEvidence: Exactly one present, untruncated assessment-model entry; its JSON text equals accepted rootCause
requiredCause: status hypothesis or unknown; null ruleId; all root/mechanism/hypothesis refs resolve to baseline evidence; every proposed hypothesis has evidenceRefs, missingEvidence, nextChecks
outcome: Baseline records production collector outcome; existing live-test receipt does not contain outcome, so cross-receipt outcome equality cannot be asserted
scope: Offline baseline only; no live model, denial challenge, network or service qualification
